snippet.title: GeForce 8800 GTX - 20 Years of a Legend
snippet.description:
Celebrate 20 years of the iconic GeForce 8800 GTX with a semi-interactive tech demo created by Dylan Browne, brought to life with DLSS 4.5 with Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, Ray Reconstruction, path tracing, and Mega Geometry! 

Revisit the GPU that introduced CUDA and took on Crysis - step into a 2006-era PC gaming room, unbox the GPU, and install it in an era-accurate PC tower. Can you spot the hidden easter eggs? 

Download GeForce 8800 GTX - 20 Years of a Legend for free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4910040/
